# Diffen

> > Diffen is a comprehensive comparison and reference site that explains the differences between similar concepts, products, and topics across health, technology, science, food, business, and finance domains.

Diffen provides side-by-side comparisons and educational guides to help users understand distinctions between everyday items, financial concepts, and technical specifications. The site covers major categories including personal finance (taxes, insurance, stock options), consumer technology (Android vs iOS, networking standards), food and beverages, and health topics.

## Key Topics

- Tax deductions
- Stock options
- Dividend taxation
- Android vs iOS
- Mobile operating systems
- Networking standards
- Sugar substitutes
- Coffee makers
- Audio systems
- Batteries
- Insurance plans
- Medical conditions
- Tech hardware
- Comparison guides
- Personal finance

## Personal Finance & Taxes

- [Taxation Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Taxes): Taxation category index for tax concepts, deductions, and income type comparisons
- [Itemized vs Standard Deduction](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Itemized_Deduction_vs_Standard_Deduction): Guide comparing itemized and standard tax deductions with IRS forms and filing status
- [Tax Credit vs Tax Deduction](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Tax_Credit_vs_Tax_Deduction): Educational comparison of tax credits vs deductions and their financial impact
- [Qualified vs Non-qualified Stock Options](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Qualified_vs_Non-qualified_Stock_Options): Guide to ISO and non-qualified stock options tax treatment and capital gains
- [Ordinary Dividends vs Qualified Dividends](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Ordinary_Dividends_vs_Qualified_Dividends): Comparison of dividend taxation rates and holding period requirements
- [Insurance Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Insurance): Insurance category with health and life insurance plan comparisons and terminology
- [Business Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Business): Business category covering corporate structures and financial concepts

## Technology & Devices

- [Android vs iOS](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Android_vs_iOS): Comparison of Google Android and Apple iOS mobile operating systems and ecosystems
- [Technology Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Technology): Technology category with product and hardware comparisons including Apple TV, AMD, Intel
- [Cat5e vs Cat6](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Cat5e_vs_Cat6): Technical specification comparison of Ethernet cable standards and bandwidth
- [5.1 Surround Sound vs 7.1 Surround Sound](https://www.diffen.com/difference/5.1_Surround_Sound_vs_7.1_Surround_Sound): Audio system comparison of surround sound channels and speaker setup requirements
- [Duracell vs Energizer](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Duracell_vs_Energizer): Battery comparison covering life, safety, and environmental impact of both brands

## Science & Health

- [Health Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Health): Health category index with comparisons of diseases, conditions, and medical topics
- [Science Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Science): Science category index covering AC/DC, AM/FM and other scientific comparisons

## Food & Beverages

- [Food Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Food): Food category with ingredient and culinary comparisons including sugars and cheeses
- [Splenda vs Stevia](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Splenda_vs_Stevia): Sugar substitute comparison covering artificial vs natural sweetener options
- [Keurig vs Tassimo](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Keurig_vs_Tassimo): Single-serve coffee maker comparison of pod systems and brewing technology
- [Sashimi vs Sushi](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Sashimi_vs_Sushi): Japanese cuisine comparison of raw fish preparations and nutritional differences

## Home Improvement & Materials

- [Home Improvement Category Index](https://www.diffen.com/difference/Category:Home_Improvement): Home improvement category comparing materials like PVC, ABS, aluminum, and vinyl
